Your worksheet and Azure pricing calculator
The goal is at most $25 per month across services and licenses, not a prepaid package or a
guaranteed Azure cap. Inventory existing commitments first.
Price the actual Defender plan/scope, any Azure VM hours, disks, logs, storage and external
Microsoft licenses before enabling them. Leave a buffer: for example, stop optional practice at
a $10 forecast rather than planning to use every dollar. Rates, billing delay, tax and usage
Start with local VMware/Wazuh and no new cloud VMs. Trials are optional and eligibility is not
guaranteed. If no acceptable trial or priced paid plan is available, finish the free lessons
Check: You have a written estimate, early stop threshold and the choice to continue free.
